alt: A satin ribbon arcs from a late afternoon sky into the first light of morning over paper fields.
prompt: Flat faceted paper fields under a wide sky that shifts from the deeper blue of late afternoon at the right to the pale first light of morning at the upper left. One satin ribbon in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan arcs across the whole sky from the afternoon side into the morning side, where a faceted paper blossom is just opening at its end: an afternoon’s work arriving at the start of a day. Calm sky in the upper left quarter. Portrait, about 8:9, safe to crop to 4:5. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right.
